versions.changelog:
Initial release of the higress-gateway-management skill.

- Provides commands and guidance for managing Higress AI Gateway via its Console API.
- Supports consumer, AI route, and LLM provider management, including create, update, and delete operations.
- Session cookie authentication instructions included.
- Highlights environment variable usage for seamless integration in Manager containers.
- Guidance for AI provider registration and AI route configuration, with clear separation from generic route management.
- Notes on version handling, auth plugin activation time, and interoperation with MCP server management skill.
